name: am-rulespec-2026-08-30
description: Immutable Armenian current-law tax-benefit core plus a bounded historical evidence selection for supervised RuleSpec-AM encoding. The historical scope includes the 2024 Q1 and year-end Tax Code expressions, the three Funded Pensions expressions spanning 2024, and the operative minimum-wage expression; it does not claim an exhaustive 2024 Tax Code expression timeline.
